prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque background plate for a 2D side-on fighting-game stage. Deliver a single landscape 16:9 PNG, ideally 1672×941, at native output resolution. High-quality detailed painted game environment, sober realistic materials, faithful to the attached exact Silent Hill references. No UI, title, watermark, frame, characters, enemies, humans, silhouette, blood effects or invented symbols. This is a scene adaptation for a fixed combat camera, not a claim of exact original geometry. Keep the ground in the bottom 30% as an unobstructed horizontal fighting lane; the feet baseline is at about 87% of image height. No camera roll, no fisheye, no high aerial/isometric view. Do not place large foreground objects across the center; the separate foreground will be produced later.
Exact scope: SILENT HILL f, normal Fog World Ebisugaoka main street, the wooden corner shop seen in both official PlayStation screenshots. Images 1 and 2 are visual references for the SAME shop and same normal phase; use Image 1 as primary architecture and Image 2 only to clarify the frontage. Recompose this one storefront and its immediate neighbors as a side-facing combat backdrop: dark weathered timber two-story building, tile eaves, latticed upper windows and small balcony, faded rectangular shop sign, glazed lower shopfront, red cylindrical postbox to the left of the entrance, low wooden bench, slim utility pole and overhead power wires, adjoining slatted wall and distant side alley right. Grey cloudy daytime with a little low fog; wet granular grey road and restrained small puddles. Match roofline, facade proportions, postbox design, wood tone, dull blue-grey atmosphere and spacing as closely as the sources show. Use a wide nearly straight-on camera opposite this facade, with just enough depth at the right alley. The sign lettering must remain worn and indistinct; do not add readable invented words. Do not mix the red floral Otherworld, shrine, school, or Shimizu residence into this street. No flowers, vines, creatures, modern vehicles, road signs or extra props.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: one 2D fighting-game FOREGROUND OVERLAY with TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA alpha. Output a single 16:9 image, same 1672×941 canvas as input 1. Image 1 is the completed opaque backdrop for exact scale, color and material matching only. Produce only a sparse close foreground edge plane; REMOVE EVERYTHING ELSE to true transparency. Almost the entire canvas, including all pixels between x=0.07 and x=0.93 from top to bottom, MUST be fully transparent. No opaque black/white background, no painted checkerboard, no scene, sky, road, floor strip, central object, furniture, characters, monsters, text, logo or watermark. Keep all visible material strictly in the outermost 5% at the far left and far right, irregular slim vertical cropped edge silhouettes with clean alpha. Do not show a complete rectangular frame. Foreground edges are a modest fixed-camera adaptation of attested wall materials, not a new room. Lower central foot-band y=0.72..0.95 is completely empty transparent.
Exact material: the dark weathered timber vertical siding/door-jamb edges of Ebisugaoka's wooden corner-shop street in normal Fog World. At far left, a slim shadowed vertical timber post cut by the image edge, dark grey-brown weathered grain; at far right an even thinner cut edge of the same timber siding with one subtle seam. Cold grey outdoor light. The two narrow strips should sit at the extreme canvas edges and be understated. No roof, lantern, wires, mailbox, flowers, greenery or new props. Preserve wide unobstructed view of the backdrop after compositing.

Exact scope: SILENT HILL: BOOK OF MEMORIES, Fire Zone, industrial room documented by the October 16 2012 launch screenshot (Image 1). Image 1 is the primary retail scene and Image 2 is the environment artist's material/kit reference only; do NOT copy a different room arrangement wholesale. Create the same compact rust-red workshop/fire room with close-panelled iron walls, horizontal and vertical pipes, solid rusty floor plates alternating with narrow grated channels, warm orange light glowing from BELOW the rear grates, a heavy workbench/drawer cabinet against the rear wall and a simple worn industrial table at the rear left. Reorient the camera to a nearly straight-on horizontal versus view at low chest height, widen the visible floor modestly and keep the entire bottom third solid and level for combat. Preserve the dark iron/orange palette, construction seams, rivets, grates and worn metal surfaces from the retail screenshot; orange light is illumination, no new flames or lava. Fully remove every player, monster, weapon, fire attack, HUD, map, health bar, damage numeral, and collectible. Do not import the shooting range/targets/ammunition from the artist's other Fire image, nor other elemental worlds. Keep gaps behind the combat lane only, no pit or stairs crossing the fighting floor.

At the extreme left draw one very narrow cropped shadowed rusted metal wall return, and at the extreme right a slim dark iron edge with a few small rivets. Warm low orange rim light, same iron texture as the backdrop. Keep each within its outermost 5% of canvas width. No railing across the bottom, no floor, no flames, embers, smoke, gears, machinery, doorway outline or additional props. Sparse true-alpha edge overlay only.
